t":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"五律裁衡：淬回与自修分别补本剑器气、器命，五律仍共用有限刃体资源；五行齐全不代表开放普通术法的主人养元。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.artifact-speed","weight":0.9,"affix":"allow","reason":"适量御器起手效率可用，复杂工序与长线代价仍保留。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.blade-concord","weight":1.1,"affix":"allow","reason":"五律长战可近距扶持器物，但并非同时覆盖所有分散剑路。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.tide-return","weight":1.4,"affix":"allow","reason":"多律循环允许附近飞剑补灵协作，主人灵力仍是公共成本。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.guardian","weight":1,"affix":"allow","reason":"末端土稳锋线允许低优先主人护甲培养，不改变剑体白盒。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.spirit-ward","weight":1.1,"affix":"allow","reason":"多律施用者可用灵抗抵抗术法压力，避免因多元素就宣称全抗。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.canopy","weight":0.9,"affix":"allow","reason":"木土护持允许有限范围单位防御，需付出一个随机后缀。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.hit-recovery","weight":1.4,"affix":"allow","reason":"复杂接力需要主人受击后恢复动作，保护后续出手机会。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.cast-mobility","weight":0.9,"affix":"allow","reason":"御器起手减速缓解支持长线择位，不能同时最大化航速与承压。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.blade-integrity","weight":1.5,"affix":"allow","reason":"五路结构有共同刃体承压，固刃提供器命缓冲且不免除自修条件。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.spellpower","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"五律五行齐全仍以物攻系数驱动金锋。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.vital","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"五律修复的是本剑细损，五行齐备并不授予主人气血上限。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.cloud-step","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"五律优先精确长线和有序准备，不再给高机动培养占词位。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.clear-water","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"一成水律用于淬回，不把复杂锋线培养成主人水路行走专长。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.water-mending","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"水律回器气、木律修剑缝，均没有主人水滋养承诺。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.physical-speed","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"真实锋线仍由御器动作发起，不读手持近战速度。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.spell-speed","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"五段元素工序不改变御器类别，法术速度无效。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.windborne","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"御风旧词已停用；五律齐备仍有长线与准备代价，不能借神器身份恢复旧航速词。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.far-seeking","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"寻远旧词继续退出随机，五段工序只在现有守护与系绳范围内完成。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.mountain","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"镇岳旧词停用；末端土律让敌人行动变慢，不能把这份控制混成旧击退增幅。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.resonant","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"共鸣旧词已停用；五律始终服务一条金锋，五行齐全不意味着扩大命中宽度。"},{"targetId":"effect.affix.enduring","weight":0,"affix":"deny","reason":"绵长旧词停用；灼痕被淬回消费，其他状态亦按本来时长，五律不获额外延时通道。"}]},"provenance":{"sourcePaths":["assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s27/effects/attacks/atlas-s27.continuous-returning-strike/effect.pack.ts","assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s27/weapon.pack.ts","src/combat/combat-runtime.ts","src/combat/returning-sword-resources.ts","src/weapon-arsenal/core-growth.ts"],"legacyNodeIds":["binding:atlas-s27:attack"]},"designNotes":["火、水、木、土各承担一段有限作用，五行齐备不代表每行都有整份伤害。","淬回消费灼痕，木律只修本剑，土律让敌人移动与动作变慢。"],"placement":{"contentPackId":"base-returning-sword","categoryPath":["weapons","atlas-s27","effects","attacks"],"scope":"exclusive","owner":{"kind":"weapon","id":"atlas-s27","name":"五律裁衡"}}}}
